scenarios.evidence_output: verified ProjectIdentity or typed scope_mismatch/no-op envelope with next_tools
scenarios.escalation_boundary: multiple plausible roots or operator confirms unusual safe root

scenarios.trigger: compaction/model switch/session resume with uncertain Workpoint
scenarios.evidence_output: WorkpointResumePacketV2 or explicit noncanonical recovery packet
scenarios.escalation_boundary: no canonical packet and operator ask unclear

scenarios.trigger: evidence link or Workpoint packet returns scope_mismatch
scenarios.evidence_output: proof preserved as evidence handle or blocked with do_not_retry_unchanged posture

scenarios.trigger: hot timeout, LowMem, or full payload request under pressure
scenarios.evidence_output: bounded degraded envelope with rehydrate refs and no official tool disappearance

scenarios.trigger: task completion/closure or work-loop mutation requested
scenarios.evidence_output: closed bead includes code/spec/evidence citations or remains open with missing-evidence gap
scenarios.escalation_boundary: writer conflict, destructive action, or verification impossible
